reference_objective: Token-weighted next-token cross entropy plus z loss 1e-7; no weight decay
precision: Production code and compute policy generate directions; FP32 parameters, loss, gradients, HVPs and perturbations for all reference measurements
physical_length_reference: Full or matrix-only alpha=1/8 update norm from same checkpoint and draw
finite_difference_gate: Relative mean-HVP error below 2% at two adjacent declared perturbation scales; both powers at draw zero origin and full endpoint; matrix-only origin

quadrature.method: Composite Simpson on independently measured signed directional Hessian products
quadrature.paired_error_rule: Refine until paired prediction residual <= max(2e-6,20% of observed paired loss difference); flag unresolved at maximum

heldout_fit.unit: Whole checkpoint, including all paths and draws
heldout_fit.primary_scope: Full-update paths; fixed canonical positions; 64 reference sequences
heldout_fit.weighting: Equal total weight per checkpoint; fixed canonical positions only, excluding adaptive refinement points

adaptive_phase.only_after: All six states complete and cross-checkpoint models fit
adaptive_phase.normalization: Set each rule scalar grid to median calibration-state lengths 0.1,0.3,1 times median calibration reference norm
adaptive_phase.physical_cap: [0.01,3] times median reference norm in the calibration checkpoints; same cap for every rule and power in a fold
adaptive_phase.calibration: Directly evaluate each candidate on the other five checkpoints, equally weighting checkpoints, powers and update draws
adaptive_phase.evaluation: Evaluate the selected scalar directly on the held-out checkpoint; never choose it with held-out losses

stages: early and late after pilot gates
